t: This is the Viktor Wynd Museum of Curiosities, Fine Art and Natural History, on Mare Street in Hackney. It's both a museum and a bar, set in a former call centre. It's run by Viktor Wynd, a British artist, author and curator known for his collections of curiosities, and it's part of The Last Tuesday Society. The museum was funded through a Kickstarter campaign in 2015. So what you're standing at is one collector's personal passion, turned into a public place.
